description: List all available pre-reasoned market briefings with tier requirements. Returns 25 LIVE briefings across Free (6), Basic (8), and Pro (11) tiers. The company briefing (equities.company) is one listed company per call, on Pro and above: 126 Indian company briefings counted on 2026-10-03. Covers Bitcoin, macro, FX, and cross-asset financial data categories. No authentication required.
